title: Implementation team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/implementation.yaml: the team layer of the implementation plugin's settings. Resolution, layer order and the per-key exceptions: plugins/implementation/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0054-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

verify_mechanical_phases.description: When true, /implementation:implement and /implementation:implement-dispatch send every phase, mechanical ones included, to a fresh-context verifier. A floor: true in this file or in the user's verify_mechanical_phases option wins, so neither layer can switch off the other's true.

drain_cadence.description: When /implementation:implement-dispatch reads worker returns. on-arrival: verify each return as it comes in. batched: hold returns until the orchestrator step in progress (composing a wave's fences, a build gate, a phase-boundary commit) finishes, and at phase end. Overrides the user's drain_cadence option.

code_writing.description: Who writes the code when /implementation:implement runs an approved plan. inline: the session edits, unless the run is autonomous or the plan routes phases to workers. dispatch: every phase goes to /implementation:implement-dispatch, which writes worker rows for phases the plan leaves to the main session. Overrides the user's code_writing option.

per_unit_check.description: How /implementation:implement checks a change applied at three or more sites, once the lever or the hand edit is ready. pilot: apply it to a few units, check them, then apply the rest with one check at the end. every: run the check after each unit. Overrides the user's per_unit_check option.

integration_posture.description: How far a change reshapes the code around it. by-kind: a feature is a day-one redesign (the surrounding code is reshaped as if the feature had been there from the start), a fix or a config change is minimal, a refactor keeps the plan's scope with behavior unchanged. day-one: features, fixes and config changes all take the redesign. minimal: they all take the smallest change. A refactor keeps the plan's scope under every value. /planning:plan reads this key to write a day-one redesign as plan work items; /implementation:implement applies it only when no approved plan exists. Overrides the user's integration_posture option.

refactor_compat.description: What /implementation:implement does in refactor mode with the shape it replaces. same-wave: update all call sites and remove the replaced shape in that same change, unless code outside the repository (a public API, a published package) relies on it. deprecate: keep an adapter, with a removal condition, for every consumer. Overrides the user's refactor_compat option.

competing_attempts.description: What /implementation:implement-dispatch does with a phase the plan marks multi-shape. off: one attempt, the mark is ignored. suggest: offer competing_attempt_count attempts with a cost line; an unattended run makes one attempt and logs a discovery entry. auto: run the attempts without asking, on marked phases only. Overrides the user's competing_attempts option.

competing_attempt_count.description: How many attempts /implementation:implement-dispatch runs for a marked phase when competing attempts run. Attempts count against the dispatch wave cap; a count above the cap runs in sequential waves. Overrides the user's competing_attempt_count option.
